name: synology-mcp
description: Use a Synology NAS (DSM 7) from Claude: files, Synology Drive, Download Station, Container Manager (Docker) and NAS status.
long_description: Browse, search, read and organise files on your Synology NAS (File Station), use Synology Drive labels, stars and shares, manage Download Station (URLs, magnets, .torrent files) and check the NAS status (temperature, disks, volumes; some need an admin account). Read-only unless you turn writes on. The extension only can do what the DSM user you configure is allowed to do.

url.title: NAS URL
url.description: DSM address with port (http://192.168.1.10:5000, https://nas.example.com:5001) or quickconnect:<your QuickConnect ID> to reach it from anywhere

username.title: DSM user
username.description: Preferably a dedicated, non-admin user with access only to the shared folders Claude should see

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: When on (default), only reading tools are available. Turn off to let Claude create, move, delete and add downloads

insecure_tls.title: Accept an invalid HTTPS certificate
insecure_tls.description: Only for https URLs with a self-signed or expired certificate, on a network you trust

device_id.title: 2FA device token
device_id.description: Only for accounts with 2-step verification: the SYNOLOGY_DEVICE_ID printed by `npx synology-mcp register-device`
